meta: How to use keywords in Content

post_content:
Do you know how to use keywords or how to use long-tail keywords in Content? If you are looking for the answer, you are in the right place. 

Using the keywords properly is a significant part of SEO and content writing. When you want to rank your content for a specific keyword, there is no alternative to using keywords properly. 

There are certain methods of keyword use that we will share with you.

But we will discuss how placing keywords in the content can be your trump card.

There are some secret tips that will help you to rank faster than ever, and it’s completely suggested practice. 

 

Let’s jump into a complete guide to keyword placement- where to use keywords for SEO. Before that, we will start with some basic concepts. 

 

What is a keyword? 

 

A keyword can be any word that people search on the internet. This is a basic definition, but we are not going to explain only with the traditional definition; let’s start with an example. 

 

You may search: Nugget recipe 

And here is the answer in the SERP.

This “nugget recipe” is a keyword, and the ranked blogs are about how to make nuggets. Now think again; you may also search for it as “how to make nuggets”. And here is the result. 

Though all results are not the same, you will get similar info on the SERP page. Now, what about writing it differently? Well, we can search for “nugget making process”. Here is the result: 

As you can see, whatever you search is a keyword, and though the search intent is the same, the variation of words can change the SERP result. 

 

You can ask, how many types of keywords are available? Well, you can decide in many ways. like, based on the character count- we decide them as 

 

  • Short-tail keywords 
  • Long-tail keywords 

 

We have already shown the example, nugget recipe is a short-tail keyword, and how to make nugget is a long-tail one.

When you want to learn about how to use keywords in Content, you should know how to use both long-tail and short-tail keywords in Content and short-tail. 

 

We can create a type of keyword in another way based on the search intent. They are: 

  • Informative Keywords 
  • Navigational keywords 
  • Commercial Keywords
  • Transitional Keywords 

 

Here is a detail; check it out!

What is keyword research? 

 

This is another basic concept and one of the most popular words in SEO – Keyword research. Keyword research is a key factor of SEO, no doubt.

If you ask what keyword research is, the easiest way to explain it is finding out how people search a particular topic. 

 

Let me give you an example. Suppose you have a website on the beauty and skin care niche.

You want to sell skincare and makeup products. Now, how can keyword research help? 

 

You will find out how people are searching on the internet about makeup products and skin care.

Use the keywords in your content, optimize it, and it will appear in the search results.

That’s how it works, well not in this much simple way, there are complications. You can read this blog about: 

 

If you use short-tail, highly competitive keywords, then you may have to use the keywords more often. You cannot avoid it even if you want to.

There is a standard number, 2 Percent, but it doesn’t always work.

So when you are targeting a keyword, short tail and high difficulty, you can use the focus keyword about 10 times in 1000 words.

Again, this is not a static number that you must follow. This is for your convenience so that you can make an assumption.

 

Hope you have understood how to do keyword research.

 

What is keyword Stuffing? 

 

 

Keyword using and keyword Stuffing are closely related to each other. When you use your keywords in your content, it helps the search engine to understand the topic.

But what if you use the keywords too much? Well, this is called keyword stuffing, which is completely harmful for SEO. 

But how do you get rid of keyword Stuffing? It sounds easy, because you may think “I will not use them too much”.

Well, that’s not how it can always be solved.

Because sometimes, you need to use the keywords because of the context. You have to use them to make the topic understandable. 

Now the question is, how to solve the issue? There are some steps you may follow to get rid of the keyword Stuffing issue: 

  • Make a plan for how many times you are going to use the keywords. 
  • Find out the synonyms of the keywords. If you have to use the keywords more than the expected number, use them. 

Remember, keyword Stuffing is harmful to SEO. A few years ago, we saw people using it as a trick, and it worked.

Google ranked the content with keyword Stuffing. But with the updates of the Search engine, the sites got penalized, and it is going on.

So, if you do not want to face any trouble, do not do keyword Stuffing. We have a detailed article about keyword Stuffing; read it for more information. 

 

What is Keyword stuffing? 

 

What is keyword difficulty? 

 

 

Keyword difficulty is one of the common words as well, we can see it everywhere about keyword research.

In a basic sense, how difficult it is to rank a keyword is called keyword difficulty. To learn more about it, read our blog about : 

What is keyword difficulty?

How to use keywords in Content? 

 

You have to use keyword phrases following some basic rules while creating content: 

  • You cannot do keyword Stuffing 
  • You have to use them accordingly 
  • Use the less difficult keywords to rank faster

These are basic rules that you must follow. But you need to know where and how to use the keywords in a blog post, right?

 

Keywords in Title Tag:

 

 

Using your primary keyword is recommended and helpful for SEO.

So, when your content appears in a search query, it helps the reader to understand what your blog is about. It also helps to appear in voice searches.

 

 

Keywords in the introduction:

 

Using keywords in the introductory paragraph or head term is the best practice of search engine optimization.

You have to use the main keywords or focus keyword at least once in the first 100 words.

We suggest using the keywords right in the first line, However, you can use it later also, but must be in the first 100 words.

Using keywords inthe  introduction is significant because: 

  • It helps the reader to understand what you are writing about. 
  • Search engine crawlers can understand your context easily. 
  • It amplifies your ranking factor. 

 

Keywords in the meta description:

 

Meta description is an important part, this is what a user sees first when they search for something. So you have to use the keywords in the meta description part. As the meta description is only 160 characters, you can use keywords only once. 

Keywords in the body:

 

We always get questions: How to use keywords in the body? How many times should we use the focus keyword in the body? Well, the answer is not static; there is no magic number. Because: 

 

  • If you use short-tail, highly competitive keywords, then you may have to use the keywords more often.

         There is a standard number, 2 Percent, but it doesn’t always work.

          So when you are targeting a keyword, short tail and high difficulty, you can use the focus keyword about 10 times in 1000 words.

          Again, this is not a static number that you must follow. 

  • When you are targeting a long tail and less competitive keywords, you can use the keyword 2 or 3 times in the body; that is enough and will not make any stuffing.
  • You can use paid & free tools to count the number of keywords.

 

Keywords in the conclusion:

 

For the conclusion, endnote, or wrapping up whatever you say, use the keyword once in the last 100 words.

It means a lot and is a very helpful tactic for SEO. And if you are targeting a short-tail keyword, you can use it more than once.

However, your total keyword usage should be maintained with the word count. 

Number of Words and Keyword Use:

 

Last but not least, keyword use varies with the number of words of the content.

If your blog is 2000 words, then you may use the focus keyword 6/7 times.

But will it be the same in the case of the 1000-word Content? Of course not! It will differ.  It will be less. 

Using Secondary Keywords or LSI: There can be many keywords that you are not focusing on, but as they are related to the topic, you will cover them also. Let’s give an example: 

Your focus keyword is: Best Mobile phone under 100 dollars. 

Here, you can cover different topics related to the main context. Your secondary keyword or LSI keyword can be: 

-Mobile phone price 

-Cheap Mobile phone 

-Smart phone price 

When you want to learn about how to use keywords in content writing, here comes the question: how many LSI keywords you use? 

There are different opinions about it. But we got good results using them 1 or 2 times in the content. Each keyword in one content, it helps to rank in different keywords. 

Keywords in Anchor Text: You can also use your keywords in the anchor text of your internal and external links.

But do not use the main keyword; try to use the LSI keywords in the anchor text.

If you use the focus keyword, it may accelerate the bounce rate and lower the user experience as well as lose your target audience.

 

Semantically Related Keywords: There may be some short-tail keywords that are related to your context.

Enriching your content by using them can help a lot to make it easier to rank.

Maintain it on all pages of your site. You can find them out easily with the SEMRush Tool.

But manually finding out is a little bit complicated. We will post a blog about it soon! 

Read more about it here: What are semantically related words?

Wrapping Up 

Hope you have a good idea about how to use keywords in Content and how many times you should use.

Do not do keyword Stuffing, and use them properly. If you write good-quality content, then you can appear in Google search results easily.

Good-quality content always includes keyword optimization because it is an integral part of SEO.

post_content:
Content is the king, but only when you know how to write SEO-friendly blog posts. But the question is, how to write SEO-friendly blogs?

According to Letter.ly, 7.5 million blog posts get published every day.

 But how many of them get ranked? About 1% only. Now think, what about the rest of the blogs? 

Yes, you guessed right, they never get traffic. But writing SEO friendly blog posts can be your trump card and the only way to get traffic. 

Some easy and simple steps can make your content optimized for search engines. But you have to maintain all of them and do them in an accurate way. 

So, to give you a proper and complete guide on  how to make SEO friendly blog, we are here.  

Before diving into the topic, for beginners here’s an overview about what “SEO friendly blog” actually means. 

 

What is SEO friendly blog 

 

 

We read so many things everyday, like books, social media posts and other writings. But there are some basic differences between regular writing and web content. Web content should be optimized for search engines. 

But why, and how? 

First think about how the search engine works. When a user searches for something, an information or products, the search engine shows relevant results in the SERP page. 

But how does the search engine define which blog will be in the first page/search result? When you optimize your blog for search engines properly, search engine crawlers rank the page in the first page. 

So, An SEO friendly blog is a blog where the keywords, page, context is well optimized for search Engine. 

When you know how to write SEO friendly blogs, half of your task is done (other half includes technical and off page SEO). 

Blog without SEO- How it impacts? 

 

 

Blog without SEO will bring no impact on your website.

Whether your target is sales, brand promotion or anything else – you need to make your content optimized. We get a question so many times: 

 

 

Does a blog rank without SEO? 

Is a blog without SEO effective? 

Are there any negative effects of blogs without SEO? 

 

Well, firstly, a blog can rank without doing SEO properly. But without any kind of optimization, it is quite impossible to rank and when you write about a topic in which enough content are not available, then Google ranks the content even if the content is not well optimized. 

A blog without SEO is not effective. Because it does not rank, does not bring traffic, does not help you to sell and ultimately your ROI will be 0. No matter how many contents your website has, it can be 10, or 100- if it is not optimized you cannot expect anything from it. 

When you do not know how to write SEO friendly blog posts, it may affect negatively on your site.

Let me explain. When you continuously publish contents that are not ranking, search engine defines your site as less authoritative.

So the site authority goes down. There is no direct negative effect like penalty, but it has far reaching impact on your website. 

How to write SEO friendly blog posts

 

 

1. Start with Keyword research 

 

 

When you think about the SEO optimization in your content, the first thing you should consider is relevant keywords research. Now let me answer, Why is keyword research important for SEO? 

There are multiple reasons. But when your content consists of the popular keywords, search engines rank it for that query. Here is an example: 

 

 

 

Look for closure on both of the keywords. The search intent is the same in both cases, that is- looking for some tools for SEO optimized content writing.

Now, if you enrich your writing with the first one, you may rank for that keyword.

Even if the second keyword’s search intent is the same, this keyword is not going to help because people are not searching this way, the search volume is referring so. 

To learn more about it, read our following content: 

how to use keywords in Content? 

 

2. SEO friendly blog titles- Important! 

 

 

Optimized blog post includes everything, from title to meta description, you have to write everything well.

Blog title is a part of on page SEO, and this SEO tips is vastly used.

There are some best practices for writing SEO friendly blog titles.

Here is a checklist for writing SEO friendly blog titles: 

 

  1. Title should be within 55 characters, it is the best practice. However, there are always exceptions. There are so many 
  2. Use numbers, like “10 free tools for SEO” instead of Free tools for SEO, it works better. 
  3. Avoid click bites, but use existing titles, as like “Don’t miss the latest Google core updates”. 
  4. The title must contain your focus keyword, and it will be better if you use it in the first part of the title. 

 

This short checklist is fine, if you follow it properly, your title can be called “SEO optimized”. It’s one of the most significant part of On-Page SEO. 

 

 

3. Write a Perfect Introduction

 

 

The starting is a significant part of SEO, because if you cannot attract your reader in the first paragraph, the percentage of bounce rate increases. There are many suggested writing methods for introduction writing. But we will share the unique one that we use on our own. We follow some common, easy rules too, but in our own way. 

 

  • We use the Main keyword in the first 100 words, and we try to use it just in the first line. It works, always. After 
  • The introduction includes some data, researched based, that is a sign that your content is well researched. 
  • Avoid making internal and external links in the first paragraph, it increases the bounce rate.
  • The introduction should contain what you are writing about, a basic overview of the topic. 

4. Create H2, H3 & H4 Properly 

 

 

There is no alternative to maintain the proper hierarchy of H2, H3, H4.

Search Engine Signifies the factor very much. However there are some advance tips that you must use.

The answer of how to write SEO friendly content includes the heading writing also. Here is the checklist for Heading making: 

  • Use the Title/ main keyword in H2 for once. 
  • Besides, Use the keyword in H3/H4 also in couple of times. 
  • The Heading should be relevant to the context, Do not use unnecessary headings. 
  • Use at least 1 heading in between 300 words, If you cannot use H3/h4, then use bullet point. Otherwise it affects the readability.  

5. Write Meta description property 

 

Meta description writing is easy, and important. Just maintain some basic rules, your meta description will be optimized. The meta description checklist is here: 

  • The meta description will be within 160 characters, and do not exceed the limit. 
  • It should contain your main keyword or focus keyword. 

 

That’s all! Follow it step by step and this will be enough. There’s no alternative to writing in an attractive way to make a position in the search engine result page (SERP), so don’t miss it. 

6.Informative Contents rank better 

 

Yes, this is not a regular SEO tactic, but when we are talking about quality content, there is no alternative to informative content.

You may use the target keyword in the information, and it works better.

Find out research and you can do your own research to give the information to the readers. 

7. Readability Score( How to increase readability score: Pro tips) 

 

 

Readability matters, the more readable your content is, the better user can relate.

Remember, the reader does not come to your site to read hard research papers, they come for easy understanding information.

That’s  in an easy way. Here are some pro tips about how to increase readability score. 

  • Use short sentences, do not exceed 20 words in a sentence. 
  • Do not use passive voice more than 10 percent. 
  • Use easier synonyms. 

8. Originality of Content 

 

 

Originality of a content is important because the copy content does not rank and is harmful for SEO.

You may take ideas for the content from the websites or YouTube, but do not copy them, keep it original.

This content strategy is significant.

9. Add Internal Links 

 

 

Internal link building is important, because your visitors do not always come from Google search.

They may come to read one article and find relevant articles, and go to it also.

It helps to rank your web Contents. That creates a link of pages on your website. 

10. Add External links 

 

 

Not only your own content link, putting relevant links of your competitors can be helpful!

However, not only competitors ,you can add any relevant external links as anchor text that may help the reader to understand a topic well. 

11. Optimize your feature photo 

 

Using relevant feature photos is important, and so many blogs miss it.

There are multiple websites like freepik, where you can find photos for free.

But we suggest making featured photos on your own, and we suggest using a static style for each feature photo. 

Never Do these things! 

  • Copy Content 
  • Keyword Stuffing 

 

SEO like a pro

 

Best tools you may use to write SEO friendly blog : Free Tools, Paid Tools 

Now come to the pro tips part. I have shared how you can optimize your content for SEO. But when you want to compete with the best quality content worldwide, you need much more than just regular one. In that case, you must use tools, both free and premium. 

Now question on your mind, what tool should I use for content writing? Well if you want to do SEO like a pro, first you need a good keyword research tool. 

You can find keywords from one of the most reliable tools with updated data. Most importantly, you will get this keyword research tool free. Already curious? 

Yes, it is Google Keyword Planner! This is a game changing tool where you can get accurate data. 

Besides, there are popular premium keyword research tools. If you ask me, which keyword research tool is the best in 2024, there are several actually.  From our experience we can suggest you the top 3 (the crown belongs to the first one): 

 

  • SEMRush
  • Ahrefs 
  • Uber suggest

 

Each of them is one of the best. Yet you will get some special benefits in SEMRush. Not only keyword research, for comprehensive content writing, SEMRush is the best ever. 

 

Here is how SEMRush can help you to find how to write good blogs for SEO. 

 

  • You can create a content template in a couple of minutes using the tool. 
  • With template, you can see the semantically related keywords that you should include in your content. 
  • You can find your competitors, and from where you can get backlinks. 
  • It will suggest the content length as well. 
  • The template includes the reading materials, so that you do not need to put effort on searching things all over the internet. 

 

Now you can ask, Is SEMRush Enough? Yes, it is enough for optimization but you may need some other tools as a writer, to make your content better. As like, grammar and plagiarism checkers. 

 

Grammar Checking tools: Grammatical mistakes create a bad impression, but to err is human. So, using a grammar checker is a safe option.

There are both paid and free grammar checkers. In recent years, the best grammar checker is grammarly.

Ideas for Personal Website Content, Personal Website Content Ideas, Content Ideas for Personal Website

post_content:
Having creative ideas for personal website content can go a long way to progressing your career, as a website is more unique than a CV or resume.

Whether you are hunting for work, trying to run a business, or selling a product, a website of your own can provide you with a healthy online presence and more credibility.

Anyone can open a page on a social media platform or business/employment platforms that are readily available. 

However, having your own website would indicate that you are more serious. 

So with all the business and industry websites around us, let’s get to know about – 

 

What is a Personal Website?

 

A personal website is a website created to showcase an individual’s work and persona.

Unlike the majority of internet web pages, it does not pertain to any particular corporation, institution, or organization.

You can denote it as a group of web pages where only your personal features, works, achievements, and contact information will be.

 

Additionally, it lets you showcase your work in your creative structure.

WorkItDaily states that nearly 56% of employers and recruiters are more impressed by an individual’s website.

On the other hand, according to Forbes, only 7% of the general population has a personal website. For millennials, the percentage is 15%. 

Of course, the percentages have increased by today.

Nonetheless, it indicates that a personal website can give you a great chance to stand out from the crowd.

Having a personal website might sound difficult at first, however, once you get the hang of it, it is pretty straightforward.

Furthermore, when you develop some personal website content ideas and implement them in a well-planned way, it creates a beautiful online presence for you.

To implement that more effectively, you can look into some simple personal website examples for ideas.

You will be able to see how creatively people have already managed to showcase their features.

Usually, you will find many colorful and vibrant features in their web content design.

Moreover, if you are more serious about your work and focusing on a professional presence, you can look into some professional personal website examples. 

Checking these out will give you a more in-depth idea about web content personalization in a more professional manner.

At the end of the day, you want to create a healthy online presence and attract people who are more aligned or appreciative of your work.

Your personal website design and personal website content allow you to do just that.

It is a great source of personal branding.

With those in mind, we are here to provide you with some amazing ideas for personal website content.

 

Ideas for Personal Website Content

 

The more decorated, organized, and personalized your personal website content is, the more attractive it will feel.

You will even feel good about yourself when your website is full of quality content.

So, with a focus on web content personalization, here are the sections and content you must have on your website for proper optimization.

Homepage

 

Your website homepage should greet people according to your persona and profession.

Decorate your homepage with your signature style, font, and colors. 

If your homepage layout is strong, so will your website.

Personal websites do not need a lot of links and sub-links.

We will explain which sections and pages will add more to your website.

However, make it so that your homepage itself will catch the eyes of the hiring managers.

Add attractive feature photos of you or content related to you.

You can also include an image of your workstation if you make it visually organized and pleasing. Look out for the color scheme.

Choosing an aesthetically pleasing color scheme for your website will highly appeal to the visual memory of your potential clients.

Include your elevator pitch statement on your homepage.

It means mentioning your passion, profession, and goal in your way.

On your homepage, do it as shortly and impactfully as possible.

This, when done effectively, will lead your visitors to be interested to learn more about you.

Needless to say, your homepage is the most integral part of your personal website design.

It will define the template of your website and lead site visitors to more of your personalized website content.

 

About Page

 

Having a crafty, short, and sweet About page will give people just what they need. An idea of you and your work.

Oftentimes, it would be the home page or landing page of your website, so make a good first impression.

Don’t make the mistake of making your about page too long.

It may have worked in the early stages on the internet. 

In today’s day and age, just having a short greeting, having a bit of personal touch, and showcasing your work and background would be enough.

Just feature these:

  • What do you work on
  • Your educational/professional background
  • A mentionable work achievement
  • Your latest project and current passion

All these pieces of information can make your About Page good to go.

This page is another sector where you are endorsing your elevator pitch.

So, make your passion and profession known to your site visitors.

Let them know what you are looking for and aiming for. All these can make your about page much stronger.

 

Contact Info

 

So now that people know about you, where can they contact you, or how can they hire you?

It is essential to let people connect with you and contact you. In that regard, attach your email and contact number if you feel comfortable.

Link your social or professional profiles as required.

It is a good idea to attach appropriate icons with the contacts.

This makes the contact content look more familiar, professional, and attractive.

A great piece of content you can create for your website is a contact form.

People can leave text messages directly there or if they have any inquiries.

It is always best to let people choose multiple options to contact you.

Whether they want to email you, text you, or contact you directly, they should have the option. 

So craft your contact information content section accordingly.

 

Portfolio

 

Your portfolio will need to feature your best work samples. This gives your viewer a hands-on experience of your work.

Visual content creator like graphic designers or photo/video editors can make their best impression in this sector.

So, if you are a graphic designer or editor, do not forget to put in your best work here to showcase to the world.

If you are a content writer or web developer, you can link your best articles and web pages here.

If you send your website to your possible employers, this is where they would focus most.

So it is very necessary to make your personal website’s portfolio section well-crafted and organized.

 

Resume

 

Forwarding a regular resume through email or hand-to-hand has become a common experience nowadays.

However, if you pass your website to your potential client or employer, it creates a different experience when they see your resume on your website.

You can take help from resume websites.

From there, you can easily form and share your resume using proper templates.

Make sure these sections are visible in your resume:

  • Your education/ qualifications
  • Your skillsets and expertise
  • Your work experiences
  • Your notable achievements

These pieces of content are very necessary for your resume, which adds to your site too.

Usually, you would add specific changes to your resume according to the need of the job you are applying for.

Since on your website, anyone from any sector can visit your resume, you can make your resume a bit more elaborate.

Try to include all your noteworthy educational and professional qualifications in your resume so that it can seem multipurpose and cover multiple grounds.

 

Professional Blogs

 

Blogs should be included in your personal website content ideas.

Blogs contain a lot of useful information and, if presented well, also generate a lot of traffic.

So whether you write your article or feature some blog articles related to your profession, it would surely enrich your personal website and make it look well-established.

Link your WordPress with your website.

Learn how to function and operate WordPress well.

Through that, you will easily be able to process, update, write, and re-write articles to your liking.

People regularly visit blogs for updates, tips, information, and fun.

So when you have well-crafted, relevant, and engaging blogs on your website, your personal website quality and viewership will automatically skyrocket.

People often comment in blog comment sections. Look after those.

Interact with them, and you will also find possible new ideas for newer content.

 

Testimonials

 

Positive word of mouth is always a plus for any personal or business venture. 

When clients or employers check your website and see authentic reviews and words from people who have worked with you or people you have worked for, it is sure to create a positive impact.

Beyond what you write about yourself, if people agree that you have a strong work ethic, you are skilled and expert in your sector, and all the related adjectives relevant to your sector, it can give you increased credibility.

To garner authentic testimonials, you can ask your formal clients and or employers to mention a brief comment about yourself and how helpful your work or skillset has been.

If they struggle to write properly, use a formal LinkedIn comment that goes with you and ask for their approval or modification.

All in all, testimonials are surely very useful among your ideas for personal website content.

 

Case Studies

 

Case studies analyze the reports of your products or services in a more detailed manner than testimonials.

So these can be even more effective than mere reviews. 

Case studies can make your website and personal profile even more credible and influence your site visitors to work with you.

It is a kind of social proof that eliminates any of your hiring managers’ doubt or trust issues.

In conclusion, case studies can be pretty effective.

 

What type of Content to Avoid for A Personal Website?

 

It is to be mentioned that while you already have some idea about what to do and not to do, it is good to be reminded so that you are aware.

Pay close attention to these points-

  • Make your about page too lengthy and uneventful
  • Don’t overwhelm your viewer or site visitors with too many collections of your work and history details. Keep some things to yourself, and focus on featuring the best ones.
  • Avoid mentioning social media platforms that are unrelated to your work and profession. 
  • Do not post images that are low in resolution or stolen from stock photos.
  • Do not post blogs that are poorly researched or misleading.
  • Do not be inconsistent with your blog posts. Regularly updating them would make your website seem more active and fresh.
  • Do not post vague testimonials that might be full of mistakes and overly flattering. Make sure they are written accordingly with approval. Keep them work-specific and simple.
  • If you feel like you can not write updated, thought-provoking blogs free of many mistakes, it is better to avoid them. If a visitor comes to your site and sees that your last post was two years ago, they can automatically assume that your website is outdated.

 

Wrapping Up – Ideas for Personal Website Content

 

It can understandably seem hard to establish a personal website at first. However, with these ideas for personal website content, you will start to feel more confident about what you can post.

The world is open to you on the internet, and through your personal website, you can connect and engage more people than ever before. 

So utilize these personal website content ideas, and make your progress come to you.

What Is SEO?

 

Simply, SEO, or search engine optimization, is a process.

This is optimizing your website to improve its ranking and visibility on search engine results pages (SERPs).

SEO involves changing your website’s design, content, and structure to make it more attractive to search engines like Google, Bing, and Yahoo.

Optimizing your website for relevant keywords and phrases can increase the likelihood that it will appear at the top of search results.

So when potential customers search for a product or service related to your business, they can find your website.

Besides, this can help drive more traffic to your website.

5 Reasons Why Your Business Should Invest In SEO

Should I Invest More In SMO Relative To SEO?

On the other hand, SMO focuses on optimizing your social media profiles and content to increase engagement and build relationships with your audience.

So, whether you should invest more in SMO relative to SEO depends on your specific business goals and target audience.

If your target audience is active on social media platforms and you want to build a strong brand presence and engage with your audience, invest more in SMO.

It could be a good strategy for your small business.

On the contrary, if you’re primarily focused on driving organic traffic to your website and improving your search rankings, invest more in SEO.

Ultimately, the most effective online marketing strategy will likely involve a combination of SMO and SEO efforts tailored to your business needs and goals.

Wrapping Up – 5 Reasons Why You Should Invest In SEO For Small Business

 

In conclusion, investing in SEO can be a game-changer for small businesses looking to increase their online visibility and attract more customers.

You can improve your website’s ranking on search engine results pages and drive more traffic by optimizing your website for relevant keywords and creating high-quality content.

Additionally, you can build high-quality backlinks and ensure your website is mobile-friendly and user-friendly.

These also contribute to your website ranking on SERPs.

The bottom line is SEO is a beneficial investment for small businesses aiming to expand and prosper in the digital era.

Even though it may initially involve a time and resource commitment due to the increased traffic, enhanced brand awareness, and higher search rankings.

So, if you haven’t already, consider investing in SEO for your small business today!

meta: Marketing For Websites, Marketing For A Website, Websites For Marketing, Marketing A Website, Marketing Of Website, Marketing For A Website, Marketing Strategies For Websites, Website Marketing Strategy, Website Marketing Ideas

post_content:
Your website is one of your most prominent marketing channels. So, you must know these 10 ways of marketing for websites for your better growth.

As a business owner, if you already have an established website, you know how much effort and hope you have behind your empire.

However, if you do not know how to market your website better on the internet, how can you possibly hope to reach those dreams and goals?

That is why it is a must for your marketing campaign to have marketing strategies for your website.

Marketing for a website is a not-so-daunting task.

Social media and other digital platforms have grown immensely. They have also become more available and accessible to everyone.

So, your opportunity of marketing for a website has increased tenfold.

You just need to be aware of these tremendous opportunities.

Just because of a prior lack of experience, many business owners keep wandering in a circle.

However, you do not wish to be among them. That is why you are here.

So here we are to make you familiar with what marketing for websites truly means.

You will be able to find out why marketing for a website is so important.

And additionally, you will be able to understand what are the perfect ways of marketing a website.

Furthermore, you will have some must-have website marketing strategies and website marketing ideas.

You can jot them down for sure success, as a written vision of your strategy is very important.

So lets begin with the question, what is marketing for websites? Do you understand website marketing properly?

 

What Is Marketing for Websites?

 

Marketing for websites means the process of promoting your website(s) on other platforms.

Your website should appear on the search engines as long as your webpage is minimally optimized.

If you have a proper description and navigation structure for your website, search engines would promote it automatically.

However, search engine optimization is only a part of it now. You need to think one step ahead of the competition.

The vast majority of marketing for websites is already conveyed through experienced marketing strategy templates. You can not through them away either.

So your marketing for website should be a mixture of the old along with the new.

Old Marketing Strategies

You need to integrate what worked before. Offline marketing like TV commercials or billboards can increase exposure, but will only get you so far.

Direct affiliate marketing is also a core marketing idea. However, you need the recent marketing strategies even more.

New Marketing Strategies

In modern times, search engine optimization (SEO), Email marketing, all of these will hold their places.

In addition, capitalizing on social media marketing, PPC marketing, Video marketing, and other sorts of content marketing will really help your campaign.

Regardless, your website marketing campaign should be written down. What you have in your head needs to be neatly visualized for others to see.

It is a great way to make your visions come true. Otherwise, you could be in a “ship without a radar” scenario.

So not to forget, you need to 1. Have a strategy planned out, 2. Need to integrate the old with the new, 3. Keep up with the competition and do it before them.

All things considered, we know you are wondering, how do I get customers to your website?

The first thing of course would be to cater to your customers.

After you have found your potential customers and target audience, it is your duty to create your own unique personal website.

You can learn more from our article Best 5 Ideas for Personal Website Content.

If you are branding your personal website, this will help you understand what you can put up on your website.

If you are a business owner, there will be more to learn about how do you market a website.

We are elaborating upon that in the section below.

 

How Do You Market A Website?

 

The first thing you need to do will be to identify your target audience.

Your potential customers are ready to buy. In addition, you must have it pictured in your mind who are your target audience.

So you should definitely include it in a written format when you are plotting your business marketing strategy.

Furthermore, definitely make your website interface unique and attractive.

Otherwise even a strong marketing campaign might fail.

Afterward, you can take advantage of the core ways of website marketing.

Your website SEO, Email Marketing, Blogging, Social Media Marketing, and much more would be included in this.

Now let us get into the nitty gritty of your marketing strategies for websites.

These 10 website marketing ideas will not only help you stay relevant but will also help you to move ahead.

That way you can attract more traffic to your site, reach out to more potential customers, and get familiar with the proper marketing tool or tools you need to use.

In time, you will be a pro at social media marketing. In addition, your social media platforms will have an automated stream of marketable content.

10 Perfect Ways of Marketing for Websites

 

1. Perform a Website Design Review

 

Your website is like the window for your shopping cart.

So as any shop ever created, it should look neat, clean, and decently decorated from the outside.

On the inside, it should look well organized, so everything is found accordingly.

So just like a shop, is a website a form of marketing?

Of course, it is!

That is how your website should also actually be.

To take care of these, you need to keep these simple things in mind.

Have A Proper Website and UX Design

Just like in a shop, your customers would not like to get confused traveling around in isles without directions.

Similarly, your website should also have a proper UX design. With proper navigation, copywriting, and design, your website’s user experience is sure to increase.

A Simple Website Structure

Make sure your website’s site structure has a simple hierarchy.

Any webpage should not take more than 3 clicks to reach from your homepage to access.

Proper Information

Additionally, make sure it has all the accurate information about your business, products, and services.

Mobile-friendly and Loading Time

Last but not least, try to make sure your website is mobile-friendly and your website’s loading time is decreased.

Many visitors scroll blogs or websites from the comfort of their smartphones on the go nowadays.

So a mobile-friendly site structure would keep you ahead.

Your landing page should also take minimal time to load to increase

Of course, if you manage to increase user experience, you will have more acquired customers in addition to retaining customers.

You can find out more about UX copywriting from our blog The Ultimate Guide to UX Copywriting 2025.

 

2. Make Your Site SEO Optimized

 

You must have an SEO strategy for your website as a lot of traffic is garnered solely from search engines.

Search Engine Optimization SEO for short is the process that helps you rank.

Nowadays, it is not only limited to search engine results, but social media platforms also follow SEO.

Increasing your website’s visibility will definitely increase exposure, traffic, familiarity, and in time, more conversions and sales.

So focus SEO on these factors.

SEO Content

Whether you are writing a blog, a caption, or a description, try to make sure your writing has all the necessary keywords.

Local SEO

Chances are, you do not have an international business. So you should optimize your website according to your region of jurisdiction.

Location-aware searches will help you get the customers you can actually serve or deliver products to.

So plan your SEO accordingly to capitalize on it.

On-Page SEO

Google searches and similar search engines use web crawlers. These are bots that help the search engines find out which contents need to be featured in their search result.

Your duty to improve on-page SEO is to understand how these crawlers can find your website, your article, and your content.

Properly understand the keyword usage and search volumes of the keywords to make your webpages SEO-friendly. Also, make your content easy to read and accessible.

A combination of these will make your on-page SEO on point.

Off-Page SEO

As we have already mentioned, search engines crawl your website to check relativity, authenticity, and authority.

Outside of your content, the number of referrals or links you have from other websites also improves your SEO.

If other websites provide links to your website or articles, those also boost authority in search results.

These are all part of your off-page SEO, which you do not do on your webpage directly.

Getting these connections and links can really help boosting your site image and it is an integral part of your website marketing strategy.

 

3. Social Media Optimization

 

Just like you use your website as a marketing tool, you can use social media as a tool for marketing your website.

In the previous segment, we have already mentioned that social media marketing is unavoidable for growth in today’s world.

Furthermore, SEO also improves your social media exposure.

With that in mind, you should definitely optimize your social media content for SEO too.

It is a good strategy to drive traffic to your website which you can feature on your social media platforms.

You can follow the following process for better improvement of your marketing strategy.

Make A Business Account

Having a business account will allow you to promote your website more prominently and frequently.

Make A Social Media Calendar

Your social media reach and success also depends on your regularity of posting.

Having quality content on a regular basis will clearly indicate more reliability.

Just create a written schedule for when you want to post what type of content.

This will keep you focused and give you a head-start.

Add Your Website Links to Your Page and Profile

Since you want to promote your website, this is something you must not forget.

Whenever you find it relevant, take the opportunity to provide the link to your website for more details.

This is a great website marketing strategy example to capitalize on.

Grow Your Following

Through regular posting and following the aforementioned process, you will reach your target audience even better.

Growing your target audience will also grow your followers, and eventually will drive more traffic to your website.

All these are great strategies of marketing for websites on social media.

 

4. Email Marketing

 

Email marketing has been working charms for blogs and websites for a long before.

So having an elaborate email list for your website marketing campaign should also be on your strategy.

People still have strong connections with their emails, especially in business and professional sectors. So do not think email is dead.

It can be great to drive traffic back to your website, let people know what’s new, or pitch them a product directly.

 

5. Use Paid Ads

 

While SEO and other optimizing factors might take some time to rank, a small paid ad campaign can really help you reach visitors and customers faster.

You can use Google Ads as an advertising platform.

That way your website will get featured on the platforms partnered with Google AdSense.

This includes paid ads on Google search results, Gmail, YouTube, etc.

You can also capitalize on Facebook Ads to feature your Facebook page or posts.

You can also use the following:

  • Google Local Service Ads
  • Advertising on Angi
  • Yelp for Business Ads
  • Microsoft Advertising (formerly Bing Ads)

If you have video content related to your website, those can also be featured through paid ad campaigns.

 

6. Use Video Content

 

Using video content is a tremendous way to gain authority, attention, and traffic for your website.

According to Tubular Insights, 77% of consumers think companies that produce online videos are more engaging.

The sales figure is also quite high for video content as a staggering 96% of consumers find videos helpful while making a purchase.

So have videos on your website.

Create a YouTube account with your business website name for marketing purposes.

As the second leading search engine is YouTube, it should definitely be a great marketing channel.

 

7. Keep Your Content Up-to-Date

 

Make sure your blogs are regularly updated.

Having a constant stream of updated content and publishing new content on a regular practice is a very good practice.

The more up-to-date your website looks, the more attractive it is.

It is also a great form of remarketing if you have newly updated content on your website which would make visitors want to revisit.

So do not miss this marketing opportunity as it is a great website marketing strategy example.

 

8. Automate Your Website Marketing

 

We are near the future where automated marketing will process many hectic heavy loads that drives people mad.

11 times more companies have been using automation than just a decade before.

In addition, recent studies have showcased that there is a 14.5% increase in sales and productivity and a 12.2% reduction in marketing with automation.

With that in mind, it is a very good idea to automate your email, ads, chats, and other social media sectors.

It can greatly reduce your cost and cut your workload, allowing you more time elsewhere.

 

9. Participate in Online Forums and Discussions

 

Engagement is key in marketing your website.

There is a saying that a customer has to come across you at least 7 times online before they are keen on making a purchase.

As a consequence, the more interaction and exposure, the better the chance of a conversion.

Online forums, Reddit, and subreddits can help you engage your target audience even further.

Talk about stuff that is related to your website topic.

Engage in fruitful discussions and talk about your website when you can.

Make proper use of Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and other discussion platforms.

Also, try to respond to the comments properly and answer the reviews of your website and services as well.

It showcases an active profile which is highly important for your website marketing strategy.

 

10. Best Tools of Marketing for Websites

 

Google Analytics Tool is the primary go-to for monitoring the traffic and sales generated from your website.

Apart from that, there are other tools you can familiarize yourself with too. They will give you a better understanding of your marketing campaign.

You can generate more website marketing ideas from that observation and analytics.

There are a few other marketing tools available online that you can use for marketing your website.

For SEO you can use the following:

  • BrightLocal for local SEO marketing
  • Semrush for keyword research and sight audits
  • Ahrefs for SEO keywords
  • Moz Pro for updated SEO algorithm changes

For Advertisements, get familiar with:

  • Google Ads and local service ads
  • Facebook Ads Manager
  • Hubspot CRM for site visitor lead generation

You should also check out Mailchimp for email marketing, Spyfu for competitor research, and Leadpages for making high-performing landing pages to put your digital ads on.

Of course, you should check Google Analytics regularly for analytics and website data research.

The key is to remember and work on these tools and the aforementioned ways regularly.

So that you will have a flow of marketing ideas for your website in your strategy.

 

 Wrapping up – Perfect Ways of Marketing for Websites

 

Overall, now you have a proper idea about how you can market your website.

Using the tools mentioned above, maintaining website structure, SEO, and social media platform presence, all are key to your success.

Additionally, you can pair up with influencers, host giveaways, promote an online course, and get more references to your site.

A well-marketed website can generate a lot of traffic which you would not get any other way. So the benefits of website marketing or advantages of website marketing are too many to count.

Hope this article will help guide you to the authentic tools and perfect ways you can use to promote and market your website starting today.

Like what you read? There’s more to be learned!

Read more from our blog.

Do you know what is robots.txt for SEO? SEO robot’s txt file is a keystone of Technical SEO. You chose the right place if you want to know.

So many SEO practitioners ignore the importance of robots.txt for SEO. 

We put so much effort into developing the best site and optimizing it for search engines.

But while putting together the mysterious SEO puzzle, we ignore easy things as robots’ txt SEO optimization.

Yes, comprehensive audit and technical SEO are very significant, we all know.

But do we know a simple, easy robots.txt can be a significant ranking factor? Optimizing it is as essential as any other technical SEO.

When Google crawlers first visit your website, it checks your robots.txt file. And not only that, you can call the robots.txt file is the guide for search engines.

Then why not optimize it properly and significantly impact your SEO efforts?

Today, we have made a complete blog about robots.txt file, what it is, how it works, and how to create it properly for SEO.

 

Robots.txt for SEO: A Complete Guide

 

What is Robots.txt? 

 

This is a file that contains instructions for bots or search engine crawlers.

Most websites include this file in their source code, yet some miss it.

But we recommend using it to improve your SEO.

Robots.txt is a text file that web admins use to tell web robots (mainly search engine robots) how to crawl their website’s pages.

The robots.txt file is part of the robots exclusion protocol (REP), which governs how robots crawl the web, access and index material, and serve that content to people.

Sometimes, bad bots are unlikely to follow the instructions, but robots.txt files are generally used to manage the activity of good bots like web crawlers.

Luckily the search engine bots are a good type of bots ad they follow the instructions.

Robots.txt files specify whether or not specific user agents (web-crawling software) are permitted to crawl certain areas of a website.

The behavior of select (or all) user agents is “disallowed” or “allowed” in these crawl instructions. 

 

Why is it important? 

 

As we have mentioned, the robots.txt file isn’t available on most websites.

Why does it gets overlooked? There is a reason behind it.

This is because Google can automatically identify and index all your site’s important pages.

They’ll also automatically exclude pages that aren’t important or duplicate other pages from indexing.

However, there are three key reasons you should utilize a robots.txt file.

 To specify Non-public Pages:

 

 You may have pages on your site that you do not want to appear in search results, like a page containing duplicate content. 

You might have a staging version of a page, for example.

Alternatively, a login page. These pages are necessary.

You don’t want random strangers to land on them, however.

In this situation, you’d use robots.txt to prevent search engine crawlers and bots from accessing specific pages.

Crawl Budget Optimization:

 

 If you’re having trouble getting all of your pages indexed, you may have a crawl budget issue.

By using robots.txt to restrict unnecessary pages, Googlebot can focus more of its crawl budget on the pages that matter.

Preventing Resources from Being Indexed:

 

Sometimes you keep the resources on your site.

It can be confidential and you may not want the search engine to index it.

So you can use robots.txt to prevent your resources from getting indexed.

 Meta directives can be just as effective as Robots.txt in preventing indexing pages.

On the other hand, Meta directives are ineffective for multimedia resources like PDFs and photos.

This is where the robots.txt file comes in.

How does a robots.txt file appear?

 

A simple robots.txt file for a WordPress website might look like this:

 

Even it can be simply:

User-agent:*

Disallow: /wp-admin/

Based on the example above, let’s go over the anatomy of a robots.txt file:

 

  • The user-agent specifies which search engines the directives that follow are intended for.
  • The symbol * denotes that the instructions are intended for all search engines.
  • Disallow: This directive specifies what material the user-agent cannot access.
  • /wp-admin/: this is the path the user-agent can’t access.

 

In a nutshell, the robots.txt file instructs all search engines to avoid the /wp-admin/ directory.

 

Let’s take a closer look at the various components of robots.txt files:

 

  1. User-agent
  2. Disallow
  3. Allow
  4. Sitemap
  5. Crawl-delay
In SEO robot’s txt file, the user-agent is listed.

 

For robots.txt for SEO, each major search engine should be assigned a user agent.

Google’s robots, for example, we call them Googlebot.

We know Yahoo’s robots as Slurp, Bing’s robots BingBot, and so on.

The user-agent record marks the beginning of a set of directives.

We consider all directives for the first user-agent record between the first user-agent and the following user-agent.

Directives can be applied to individual user agents, or they can be applied to all user agents.

A wildcard is used in this case: * is the user agent.

In the robots.txt file, a directive says “do not allow.”

 

You can restrict search engines’ access to specific files, pages, or areas of your website.

Then the search engine bot Disallow directive.

The Disallow directive follows the path that Search crawlers should not visit.

The directive is ignored if no path is specified.

Example: * User-agent

Disallow:/wp-admin/

In this case, you are directing all search engines not to visit the /wp-admin/ directory.

In robots.txt, developers use the Allow directive also.

When you invoke your Disallow directive, the search engine uses a directive to counterbalance it.

Google and Bing both support the Allow directive.

You can notify search engines to access a specific file or page within an ordinarily banned directory by combining the Allow and Disallow directives.

The Allow directive then follows the path that You can access. Search Engine crawlers do not crawl and index the unspecified directives. 

Example:

* User-agent

/media/terms-and-conditions.pdf is allowed.

/media/ is not good, and you should not use it. 

Except for the file /media/terms-and-conditions.pdf, no search engines can access the /media/ directory in the example above.

Important: ”Do not utilize wildcards when utilizing the Allow and Disallow directives simultaneously, as this may result in contradictory directives.”

Conflicting directives are an example and not suitable for robots txt SEO optimization.

* User-agent

/directory is ok.

*.html is not good, and you should not use it. Reason?

Search engines will ignore the URL http://www.domain.com/directory.html.

They don’t know if they have permission to enter.

When Google is unsure about a directive, it will choose the least restrictive option.

which implies accessing http://www.domain.com/directory.html.

Robots.txt For SEO: How to Do it?

 

An adequately made robots.txt file can be helpful for your SEO.

If you do not create the robots.txt file correctly, it will affect your SEO and ranking. Here is why:

  • Search Engines may index some pages you do not want to appear in web search. It will affect the user experience.
  • Creating a proper robots.txt file creates a positive impact on site authority.
  • Without maintaining the robot exclusion protocol, you may face issues with indexing.

Robots txt SEO optimization is significant in many ways.

Now we will explain the step-by-step guide to creating and uploading your robots.txt file.

1. Create a robots.txt file 

 

We advise you to use Notepad, Text Edit, or emacs to generate a robots.txt file for your best convenience.
 But what is the reason behind it? 
 
These text editors can create a valid.txt file with UTF-8 encoding that crawlers can read without formatting issues or difficulties.
So this is the first step to creating your robot.txt file. 
Secondly, avoid using a word processor.
This task uses a spreadsheet instead of a word processor.
Because word processors frequently save files in an incomprehensible format that crawlers may struggle to understand. 
And it can create troubles for robots.txt for SEO.
Limitations:
  • Never make a mistake in writing the name of the file. You must name the file “robots.txt” because it is case-sensitive sensitive. Therefore, you cannot call it Robot.txt, robots. Text or anything else. Otherwise, it will not work at all. 
  • There can only be one robots.txt file on your website. If you save multiple files in the same name, it will create problems. So keep one file in the name and if you already had one, update it, do not recreate another. It will help your robots.txt for SEO.
  • Maintaining the format of the file is significant too. You cannot keep the file in a random format like zipping. If you’re saving the file, make sure to save it as UTF-8. 

2. Modify the Robot.txt User-Agent

 

Setting up your user agent is the second step of your step-by-step setup.

Setting it up is very significant as User agents are crawlers.

To make your file crawlable for the search engine, you must specify them. Otherwise, it cannot recognize. 

However, luckily there is not only one way, but there are some different ways to go through three distinct approaches to creating a user-agent in your robots.txt for SEO file. Here we have explained them in detail:

 

1. Create a unique User-agent:

 

You can use your unique one. Let me explain.

Only one user-agent is defined here, and the syntax is: NameOfBot is the user agent.

Note: You may see a list of primary Google user agents/names of popular crawlers here.

 

2. Create several User-agents:

 

Not only one, you can create more than one also.

And you can do it whenever you need it.

If you need to add more than one bot, type the names of each one on succeeding lines.

We utilized DuckBot and Facebook in this example.

Example: DuckBot is the user agent. FaceBot is the user agent.

 

3. Set the User-agent to all crawlers:

 

There is another option that you can consider when you need it.

You can set the user agent to all crawlers.

Substitute an asterisk (*) for the bot name to prevent all bots or crawlers.

# User-agent with an asterisk: *

Note that the # symbol is used in comments to denote the beginning of a comment.

3. Set directives in your Robot.txt for SEO

 

Now come to the third step, the root directory.
Setting the directives is very significant, and we have already discussed is directives in the robots.txt file. 
 
Now come to the third step. 
Setting the directives is very significant, and we have already discussed is directives in the robots.txt file.  
It contains the following items:
Disallow:
The prohibit directive can  block bots from accessing a specific portion of the site.
# disallow crawling a complete web disallow: / 
Example 1: # block crawler from crawling a complete web disallow: /
Example 2: # prohibit a crawler from crawling a specified directory: /subfolder-nameme/
# Empty Disallow disallow: Example 3: # Empty Allow Allow Allow Allow Allow Allow Allow Allow Allow Allow Allow Allow Allow Allow Allow
An empty forbid indicates that the bots can go wherever they want, whenever they want.
# Disallow a specific web page: /website/pagename.html, for example.
This rule will apply to /website/pagename.html but not to /website/Pagename.html since file names are case sensitive.
Allow:
By setting this directive, you can prevent bots from accessing a particular portion of the site can prevent bots from accessing a particular portion of the sit by setting this directive.
2. Sitemap:
This command is used to identify the location of an XML sitemap linked with the website.
Example: Files with sitemaps
https://www.brandoverflow.com/sitemap.xml/sitemap.xml/sitemap.xml/sitemap.xml/sitemap.xml/
Google, Ask, Bing, and Yahoo are the only search engines that support this command.
3. Crawl-delay:
It specifies a waiting period for any crawler, allowing it to wait appropriately before loading and crawling the website content.

4. Place the Robots.txt files on your computer

 

So here, we can start our final steps.

There are a few things you can do to complete the rest of the task.

Once you’ve created a robots.txt file, it’ll be uploaded to your site’s root directory, which you can reach by going to your website’s public HTML folder in your FTP cPanel.
So here, you can place your robots.txt files on your computer. 

5. Make sure your Robots.txt file is up to date

 

Your robots.txt file is critical for ensuring that bots and search engines follow your instructions.
This should be well tested! Otherwise, it can cause a crawl delay.
Google’s Robots Tester Tool, which can be found on their Search Console page, is an excellent tool for checking the grammar and logic of this textual content.

6. Robots.txt vs. Meta Directives

 

Why would you use robots.txt when the “no index” meta tag can be used to block pages at the page level?

The noindex tag, as I previously stated, is difficult to deploy on multimedia content such as movies and PDFs.

Also, if you have thousands of pages to block, it’s sometimes better to use robots.txt to block the whole part of the site rather than individually adding a noindex tag to each one.

In some circumstances, you don’t want to waste any crawl budget by having Google arrive on sites using the index tag.

As a result:

I advocate utilizing meta directives instead of robots.txt in everything but those three particular circumstances.

They’re less complicated to put into practice. There’s also a lower likelihood of a calamity (like blocking your entire site).

Wrapping Up

 

Setting up your robot.txt for SEO is not difficult or time-consuming.

It will take less effort than any other task. But this simple optimization will create a significant impact on your SEO.

I hope this step-by-step guide will help you set up your robot’s txt SEO optimization.
